docs.summary: 3D Delaunay tetrahedralization (Bowyer-Watson) of light-probe positions. Produces the tetra vertex indices + per-face neighbour links the runtime `LightProbeVolume` walks. Probe sets are normally well-conditioned (grids / scattered points); a tiny deterministic jitter guards against exact coplanar/cospherical degeneracies.
Tetrahedralize `points`. Returns empty arrays when fewer than 4 points.
